milestone: CPU numeric array length and tensor shape queries

implementation.typed_IR: CollectionQuery(kind,input), with Length/Shape kind validated by CPU capability gate
implementation.lowering: Evaluate input once, read/check dimensions and byte range, then return extent or create managed dimension array; no input data scan/copy
implementation.continuations: Single input operand collected/remapped through kernels, imports and direct builtin task entries

contract.metadata: Exact nonnegative int64 values; dimension order preserved
contract.rank_zero: shape(rank-zero tensor) is an empty int64 array; length of that array is zero
contract.category: length requires array; shape requires tensor; no implicit interchange or conversion
contract.evaluation: Input expression executes once; its failures are preserved; no successful/partial shape result on allocation failure or cancellation
contract.placement: Completed CPU values; resident GPU queries and GPU kernel integration remain unsupported

scope: Frontend six numeric families, rank-zero/one/two/three/eight shapes, exact int64 scalar/array results, malformed typed IR and source category/arity/identity errors
20 raw helpers per variant: length for six element types, shape matrices for six types and int64/float32 ranks zero/one/three/eight
Eight FP environments, empty/high extents, lengths through 2^40, negative and overflow metadata, zero-count shapes with INT64_MAX extent
Null element payloads and arbitrary offset/strides establish metadata-only reads; no length allocations; shape allocation-failure sweeps and retained results after settlement
Malformed external metadata faults at function entry (1:4); allocation failure retains existing runtime 0:0 reporting; all owners settle and no partial array is published
Named helpers, lexical collection captures, map callbacks, direct/nested builtin workers, cached shape awaits and retained arrays after group closure
1/2/4-worker success/cancellation/deadline/admission, core allocation positions 1-8 and invocation allocation positions 1-8 with two workers; Arithmetic/Shape fault recovery
Pipelines, rank-zero length, shape indexing, awaited tensor queries, handled/unhandled expected errors, builtin function shadowing and preserving output on invalid source
Earlier array/tensor/inference/query-related frontend, source task/recovery/storage/numeric/control and selected GPU regressions; focused qualification, not full-suite coverage

remaining_gates: Device-side queries and host metadata integration for resident GPU values
General value types, modules, slicing and tensor-to-tensor reshape

additional_manual_check.name: Optimized runtime shape query to explicit constructor dimensions
additional_manual_check.source:
fn rebuild(values:[int],layout:Tensor[float32,?,?])->Tensor[int,?,?]:
  dimensions=shape(layout)
  tensor(values,[dimensions[0],dimensions[1]])
fn main():
  layout:Tensor[float32,2,3]=tensor([[0,0,0],[0,0,0]])
  result=rebuild([1,2,3,4,5,6],layout)
  length(shape(result))*10+result[1,2]
